data.title: Pantera's Morehead Talks Bessent's 'Backfire', Bitcoin
data.description: Dan Morehead, founder & managing partner at Pantera Capital joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss US Treasury Secretary Bessent's bond announcement, the future of digital asset treasuries, and crypto trading.
data.keywords: Bitcoin, Tim Stenovec, Pantera Capital, Treasury, Dan Morehead, Scarlet Fu, Bessent's, blockchain technology, Scott, US
